newsitem.title: USA: US West unit sets $4.1 bln in 6-tranche deal.
newsitem.headline: US West unit sets $4.1 bln in 6-tranche deal.

text.p: The following six-tranche debt deal from U.S. West Capital Funding , a unit of U.S. West Inc was priced on Thursday via Merrill Lynch & Co, according to market sources.
Acccording to Securities Data Co the debt offering holds the record for the largest investment grade debt offering ever.
